name: kinetic-flick-carousel
title: Kinetic Flick Carousel
description: A horizontal card carousel responding to pointer flick velocity with simulated inertial drift and boundary bounce.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Flick Velocity Carousel: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
